releaseNotes: Fixes settings saves and manual overrides by aligning bridge payloads and accepting an unset first-day value.
Hardens calendar feed validation, New York rollover boundaries, rendered-page timeouts, and failed source replacement state.
Preserves partially scheduled notification identifiers and keeps private schedule details and raw widget errors out of notifications and widgets.
Pins the published stable channel correctly and makes initial release staging safe for ignored files.
